title: True or false: World regions, Asia
intro: Decide whether each statement about Asia is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Democratic People's Republic of Korea is classified in Eastern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Democratic People's Republic of Korea in Eastern Asia.

statements.text: China is classified in Southern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places China in Eastern Asia, not Southern Asia.

statements.text: Bhutan is classified in Southern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Bhutan in Southern Asia.

statements.text: Republic of Korea is classified in South-eastern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Republic of Korea in Eastern Asia, not South-eastern Asia.

statements.text: Armenia is classified in Western Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Armenia in Western Asia.

statements.text: Kyrgyzstan is classified in South-eastern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Kyrgyzstan in Central Asia, not South-eastern Asia.

statements.text: United Arab Emirates is classified in Western Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places United Arab Emirates in Western Asia.

statements.text: Maldives is classified in South-eastern Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Maldives in Southern Asia, not South-eastern Asia.

statements.text: Kazakhstan is classified in Central Asia in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Kazakhstan in Central Asia.

statements.text: Philippines is classified in Central Asia in the UN geoscheme.
